summary.zh-CN: 启动更快、静默回复更准确，并让项目数据与项目入口更简单可靠。
summary.en-US: Faster startup, more accurate silent replies, and simpler, more reliable project data and controls.

title.zh-CN: 更快、更清晰的日常体验

body.zh-CN: 启动时不再扫描全部历史会话，历史较多时等待更短；上次意外中断的会话仍会正常恢复。
body.en-US: Startup no longer scans the full session history, reducing delays for larger histories while still recovering sessions interrupted during the previous run.

body.zh-CN: 项目注册信息与工作项统一进入本地数据库，已有 projects.json 数据会自动、完整地迁移。
body.en-US: Project registrations and work items now share one local database, with existing projects.json data migrated automatically and transactionally.

title.zh-CN: 项目入口与资料来源更清楚

body.zh-CN: 项目移除入口已移至项目行的更多菜单；项目工作区、Skills 与长期约定分别使用明确来源，产物列表也改进了去重、分页和搜索。
body.en-US: Project removal now lives in each project's More menu. Project Work, Skills, and durable agreements use explicit sources, while artifact lists improve deduplication, pagination, and search.

title.zh-CN: 静默标记不再误隐藏回复
title.en-US: Silent markers no longer hide normal replies

body.zh-CN: 只有内容完全等于 noreply 标记的回复才会静默，带有解释文字的正常回复会继续显示。
body.en-US: Only a reply that exactly matches the noreply marker is silent; normal responses containing explanatory text remain visible.

title.zh-CN: PWA 新标签页行为恢复正常

body.zh-CN: PWA 不再接管 Panel App 的在新标签页打开操作，链接会按用户选择在浏览器标签页中打开。
body.en-US: The PWA no longer captures Panel App's Open in new tab action, so links open in a browser tab as requested.

body.zh-CN: 旧的 Project Markers、.nextclaw/project.yaml、项目观察接口与 nextclaw projects observe 已移除，项目上下文改用明确的产物、Skills 和 AGENTS.md 来源。
body.en-US: Project Markers, .nextclaw/project.yaml, the project observation API, and nextclaw projects observe have been removed in favor of explicit artifact, Skills, and AGENTS.md sources.
